name: PESI
short_description: Continuing education for mental health and other licensed professionals: on-demand courses, live webinars, in-person seminars and certification programs.
long_description: PESI, Inc. (formerly Professional Education Systems Institute) sells continuing education for behavioral health, healthcare, rehab and education professionals, and says it supports CE for more than 40 professional licenses. Formats are self-paced on-demand courses, live webinars where attendees can ask questions, and full-day or multi-day in-person seminars. Live webinar credit requires watching while the event is live; recordings can be rewatched for 90 days. Certifications are issued through Evergreen Certifications, which PESI wholly owns. Approvals vary by course and profession (PESI lists approvals such as NASW contact hours), so clinicians should check each course against their own licensing board. Courses are bought individually or in bundles, with frequent sale pricing; organizations can buy a one-year team subscription with a curated library of CE-approved trainings, priced by quote.
one_liner: Pay-per-course CE for therapists and other clinicians, live, online or in person, plus team subscriptions.
best_for: Licensed therapists, counselors and social workers renewing a license who want many topic choices
Clinicians who want a certification in an area such as anxiety or trauma treatment
Group practices and agencies that want a one-year CE library for their staff
Clinicians who prefer live webinars with real-time questions over self-paced video
not_for: Clinicians who need CE approval PESI does not hold for their profession or state; approvals vary by course
Anyone wanting one flat individual subscription price published up front
Clinicians who want recorded access to a live webinar beyond 90 days without buying the recording

notes.solo-therapist: Individual courses, webinars and seminars for license renewal, with CE support for more than 40 professional licenses.
notes.group-practice: Team training option: a one-year subscription with a curated library of CE-approved courses for staff.
notes.organization: Agencies can buy a custom-branded staff training library, with discounts by number of participants and format.

pricing.notes: Individual courses, seminars and bundles are priced per item and often discounted. Organizational one-year subscriptions are quoted, with discounts based on number of participants and training format.

seo.title: PESI Review: CE for Mental Health Professionals
seo.meta_description: PESI continuing education for therapists and clinicians: on-demand courses, live webinars, seminars and certifications, plus team subscriptions.

faqs.a: Self-paced on-demand courses, live webinars with real-time questions, and full-day or multi-day in-person seminars, plus certification programs.

faqs.q: Do I get CE credit for watching a PESI webinar recording?
faqs.a: For live webinars, PESI requires you to watch while the webinar is live to receive credit. Recordings can be rewatched for 90 days after the webinar date.

faqs.q: Does PESI offer training for a whole team?
faqs.a: Yes. PESI sells a one-year subscription with a custom-branded landing page and a curated library of CE-approved trainings for staff, with discounts based on participants and format.
